units.id: mission:Academy Motto|On this particular day, the spaceport is crowded beyond belief by some arcane confluence of chance and logistics. Despite having resolved the bulk of your business the port authorities have informed you that there is no safe departure slot open for at least seven hours (and even that's not a promise). This leaves you alone to fill in your unexpected bit of time in the early morning.|227|0
units.english: On this particular day, the spaceport is crowded beyond belief by some arcane confluence of chance and logistics. Despite having resolved the bulk of your business the port authorities have informed you that there is no safe departure slot open for at least seven hours (and even that's not a promise). This leaves you alone to fill in your unexpected bit of time in the early morning.
units.italian: In questo giorno particolare, lo spazioporto è affollato oltre ogni credere da qualche arcana confluenza di caso e logistica. Dopo aver sbrigato la maggior parte dei vostri affari, le autorità portuali vi hanno informato che non c'è una finestra di partenza sicura libera per almeno sette ore (e nemmeno questa è una promessa). Restate quindi solo, a riempire quel pezzo di tempo inatteso nelle prime ore del mattino.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	(Play games on my ship.)|229|0
units.english: (Play games on my ship.)
units.italian: (Gioco sulla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	(Have a look around further afield.)|230|0
units.english: (Have a look around further afield.)
units.italian: (Do un'occhiata più in là.)

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	Not interested in getting lost in an expansive Hai city, you simply load up an entertainment console to keep you occupied for the next few hours.|232|0
units.english: Not interested in getting lost in an expansive Hai city, you simply load up an entertainment console to keep you occupied for the next few hours.
units.italian: Senza voglia di perdervi in un'enorme città Hai, caricate semplicemente una console di intrattenimento per tenervi occupati nelle ore successive.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|label|234|0
units.english: field trip
units.italian: field trip

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	The tendency of the Hai to efficiently pack people into vibrant but densely populated spaces is on full display as you navigate through throngs of Hai who mostly make polite efforts to avoid bumping into you. Colorful banners, flags, murals, and even windows all provide brilliant highlights to the oft-utilitarian architectural styles underlying them. Holoprojected welcome signs even grace the entry-ways of several apartment buildings that you pass, with caveats for door-to-door salespeople.|235|0
units.english: The tendency of the Hai to efficiently pack people into vibrant but densely populated spaces is on full display as you navigate through throngs of Hai who mostly make polite efforts to avoid bumping into you. Colorful banners, flags, murals, and even windows all provide brilliant highlights to the oft-utilitarian architectural styles underlying them. Holoprojected welcome signs even grace the entry-ways of several apartment buildings that you pass, with caveats for door-to-door salespeople.
units.italian: La tendenza degli Hai a stipare le persone in spazi vivaci ma densamente popolati è in bella mostra mentre vi fate strada fra frotte di Hai che per lo più si sforzano educatamente di non urtarvi. Striscioni colorati, bandiere, murales e persino finestre offrono squarci brillanti agli stili architettonici spesso utilitaristici che ne stanno alla base. Insegne di benvenuto proiettate in ologramma ornano persino gli ingressi di diversi palazzi che oltrepassate, con avvertenze per i venditori porta a porta.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	One apartment complex's exterior fencing bears a very large sign which your translator informs you says, "No Meme Content Here Please."|236|0
units.english: One apartment complex's exterior fencing bears a very large sign which your translator informs you says, "No Meme Content Here Please."
units.italian: Il recinto esterno di un complesso di appartamenti porta un cartello molto grande che, secondo il vostro traduttore, dice: "Niente contenuti meme qui, per favore."

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	After some time you find what appears to be a cafe, or equivalent, and sit down where you can get a good view of one of the more impressive building complexes around. After a moment a holoprojection built into the table asks you in human standard whether you'd like to order through the table or converse with a member of staff.|237|0
units.english: After some time you find what appears to be a cafe, or equivalent, and sit down where you can get a good view of one of the more impressive building complexes around. After a moment a holoprojection built into the table asks you in human standard whether you'd like to order through the table or converse with a member of staff.
units.italian: Dopo un po' trovate quello che sembra un caffè, o l'equivalente, e vi sedete dove potete avere una buona vista su uno dei complessi di edifici più imponenti nei paraggi. Dopo un momento un ologramma integrato nel tavolo vi chiede, in standard umano, se volete ordinare dal tavolo o parlare con un membro del personale.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	(Order through the table.)|239|0
units.english: (Order through the table.)
units.italian: (Ordino dal tavolo.)

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	(Order through a person.)|241|0
units.english: (Order through a person.)
units.italian: (Ordino da una persona.)

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	A friendly Hai emerges to take your order and politely informs you that there's a 10% surcharge for eating on the terrace. Since that's hardly a meaningful sum to a ship's captain you just nod and try and work out what you're eating. Eventually you settle for a sandwich with acorn butter and vegetable slices that appear to be spiced, or pickled, you're not really sure. It was the staff's top recommended item and didn't come with any follow-up questions about Hai food preferences that you couldn't answer.|242|0
units.english: A friendly Hai emerges to take your order and politely informs you that there's a 10% surcharge for eating on the terrace. Since that's hardly a meaningful sum to a ship's captain you just nod and try and work out what you're eating. Eventually you settle for a sandwich with acorn butter and vegetable slices that appear to be spiced, or pickled, you're not really sure. It was the staff's top recommended item and didn't come with any follow-up questions about Hai food preferences that you couldn't answer.
units.italian: Una Hai cordiale emerge a prendere l'ordine e vi informa con cortesia che c'è un supplemento del 10% per mangiare sulla terrazza. Visto che per un capitano di nave non è una cifra significativa, fate cenno di sì e cercate di capire che cosa state mangiando. Alla fine optate per un panino con burro di ghiande e fette di verdure che sembrano speziate, o sottaceto, non ne siete sicuri. Era l'articolo più consigliato dal personale e non è arrivato con domande di follow-up sulle preferenze alimentari degli Hai a cui non sapreste rispondere.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|label|244|0
units.english: pleasant lunch
units.italian: pleasant lunch

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	The interface is rather annoying to work with human-sized hands, but eventually you settle for a sandwich with acorn butter and vegetable slices that appear to be spiced, or pickled, you're not really sure. It was the top recommended item and didn't come with any follow-up questions about Hai food preferences that you couldn't answer.|245|0
units.english: The interface is rather annoying to work with human-sized hands, but eventually you settle for a sandwich with acorn butter and vegetable slices that appear to be spiced, or pickled, you're not really sure. It was the top recommended item and didn't come with any follow-up questions about Hai food preferences that you couldn't answer.
units.italian: L'interfaccia è piuttosto fastidiosa da usare con mani di misura umana, ma alla fine optate per un panino con burro di ghiande e fette di verdure che sembrano speziate, o sottaceto, non ne siete sicuri. Era l'articolo più consigliato e non è arrivato con domande di follow-up sulle preferenze alimentari degli Hai a cui non sapreste rispondere.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|label|246|0
units.english: finishing chat
units.italian: finishing chat

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	As you eat your strange, but actually surprisingly tasty lunch, you take note of the large text written above the gateway into the grounds for the building complex opposite you. After a moment your translator box takes note of where you're looking and reads it aloud for you.|247|0
units.english: As you eat your strange, but actually surprisingly tasty lunch, you take note of the large text written above the gateway into the grounds for the building complex opposite you. After a moment your translator box takes note of where you're looking and reads it aloud for you.
units.italian: Mentre mangiate il vostro pranzo strano ma in realtà sorprendentemente gustoso, notate il grande testo scritto sopra il cancello d'ingresso del complesso di edifici di fronte. Dopo un momento il vostro traduttore nota dove state guardando e ve lo legge ad alta voce.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	"To know is to lead, to study is to know, to serve is to study, to lead is to serve."|248|0
units.english: "To know is to lead, to study is to know, to serve is to study, to lead is to serve."
units.italian: "Conoscere è guidare, studiare è conoscere, servire è studiare, guidare è servire."

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	Naturally, your translator cannot answer questions, so you eat your lunch and leave it be until a staff member emerges to take your plate.|249|0
units.english: Naturally, your translator cannot answer questions, so you eat your lunch and leave it be until a staff member emerges to take your plate.
units.italian: Naturalmente il vostro traduttore non può rispondere alle domande, così finite il pranzo e lasciate perdere finché non arriva un membro del personale a ritirare il piatto.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	(Ask them about it.)|251|0
units.english: (Ask them about it.)
units.italian: (Chiedo loro di cosa si tratta.)

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	(Keep my thoughts to myself.)|253|0
units.english: (Keep my thoughts to myself.)
units.italian: (Tengo per me i miei pensieri.)

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	The staff member takes your plate and wishes you a lovely day.|254|0
units.english: The staff member takes your plate and wishes you a lovely day.
units.italian: Il membro del personale prende il piatto e vi augura una bella giornata.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	As they clear your plate from the table you ask them about the text on the gateway.|257|0
units.english: As they clear your plate from the table you ask them about the text on the gateway.
units.italian: Mentre ritirano il piatto dal tavolo chiedete loro del testo sul cancello.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	"Oh, that's the city Academy. It's a... uh..." she pauses for a moment and relays something in Hai which your translator immediately converts to, "non-technical university."|258|0
units.english: "Oh, that's the city Academy. It's a... uh..." she pauses for a moment and relays something in Hai which your translator immediately converts to, "non-technical university."
units.italian: "Oh, quella è l'Academy cittadina. È una... ehm..." si ferma un momento e riferisce qualcosa in Hai che il vostro traduttore converte subito in "università non tecnica".

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	Giving the box a surprised look she smiles and continues in Hai, "If you want to be a manager, a politician, a social worker, or even just a public speaker, you go to the Academy and do courses on leadership and communications. Strictly speaking, it's not necessary to go, but lots of places simply won't accept you into those sorts of roles without some sort of Academy qualification, and they really do provide some great skills. I'm actually going there next year to do a proper human language course.|259|0
units.english: Giving the box a surprised look she smiles and continues in Hai, "If you want to be a manager, a politician, a social worker, or even just a public speaker, you go to the Academy and do courses on leadership and communications. Strictly speaking, it's not necessary to go, but lots of places simply won't accept you into those sorts of roles without some sort of Academy qualification, and they really do provide some great skills. I'm actually going there next year to do a proper human language course.
units.italian: Con uno sguardo sorpreso al dispositivo, sorride e continua in Hai: "Se vuoi diventare un dirigente, un politico, un assistente sociale, o anche solo un oratore pubblico, vai all'Academy e segui corsi di leadership e comunicazione. A rigor di termini non è necessario andarci, ma molti posti semplicemente non ti accettano in quel tipo di ruoli senza una qualche qualifica dell'Academy, e offrono davvero ottime competenze. Io ci andrò l'anno prossimo per fare un vero corso di lingua umana.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	"Technically the Academies are all independent, but they all share the same motto. It's an obligatory thing too though, that's what the motto is about. I'm told most humans think it's backwards, but it's not. The Academies keep tabs on their graduates; if you lead with self-interest, serve without studying, study without learning or waste your knowledge without applying it, they've been known to revoke people's qualifications. Attendance is free, so there's an expectation that you don't waste what they spend time teaching you.|260|0
units.english: "Technically the Academies are all independent, but they all share the same motto. It's an obligatory thing too though, that's what the motto is about. I'm told most humans think it's backwards, but it's not. The Academies keep tabs on their graduates; if you lead with self-interest, serve without studying, study without learning or waste your knowledge without applying it, they've been known to revoke people's qualifications. Attendance is free, so there's an expectation that you don't waste what they spend time teaching you.
units.italian: "Tecnicamente le Academy sono tutte indipendenti, ma condividono tutte lo stesso motto. Ed è anche una cosa obbligatoria, ed è di questo che parla il motto. Mi dicono che la maggior parte degli umani lo trova al contrario, ma non lo è. Le Academy tengono d'occhio i loro diplomati: se guidi per interesse personale, servi senza studiare, studi senza imparare o sprechi le tue conoscenze senza applicarle, è noto che revocano le qualifiche. La frequenza è gratuita, quindi ci si aspetta che non si sprechi ciò che ti spendono tempo a insegnare.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	"This one is quite prestigious, but the ones near the spaceports always are." She winks. "Experience through natural exposure is worth more than what money can buy, after all."|261|0
units.english: "This one is quite prestigious, but the ones near the spaceports always are." She winks. "Experience through natural exposure is worth more than what money can buy, after all."
units.italian: "Questa è piuttosto prestigiosa, ma quelle vicino agli spazioporti lo sono sempre." Ammicca. "L'esperienza che viene dall'esposizione naturale vale più di quanto il denaro possa comprare, dopotutto."

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	A moment later your comm pad alerts you that you've been assigned a departure window from the spaceport in relatively short order.|262|0
units.english: A moment later your comm pad alerts you that you've been assigned a departure window from the spaceport in relatively short order.
units.italian: Un momento dopo il vostro commpad vi avvisa che vi è stata assegnata una finestra di partenza dallo spazioporto in tempi relativamente brevi.

units.id: mission:Academy Motto|	"Well, I must be attending to other customers. You have a great day!" she says, leaving you to go about your business.|263|0
units.english: "Well, I must be attending to other customers. You have a great day!" she says, leaving you to go about your business.
units.italian: "Bene, devo occuparmi di altri clienti. Le auguro una buona giornata!" dice, lasciandovi ai vostri affari.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|Passing down the main thoroughfare of this spaceport you almost ignore a stack of haphazardly piled crates in the median strip. It's not uncommon for recently unloaded crates to temporarily sit in front of different businesses in a port, placed conspicuously out of the way of the flow of foot traffic, but it is the disordered piling that seems out of place.|278|0
units.english: Passing down the main thoroughfare of this spaceport you almost ignore a stack of haphazardly piled crates in the median strip. It's not uncommon for recently unloaded crates to temporarily sit in front of different businesses in a port, placed conspicuously out of the way of the flow of foot traffic, but it is the disordered piling that seems out of place.
units.italian: Percorrendo il viale principale di questo spazioporto quasi non badate a una pila di casse ammucchiate alla rinfusa nello spartitraffico. Non è raro che le casse appena scaricate restino temporaneamente davanti a diverse attività di un porto, sistemate ben in vista fuori dal flusso dei pedoni, ma è l'ammucchiamento disordinato che sembra fuori posto.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	No sooner do you slow your step to give it your attention though, than the pile of crates immediately springs to life.|279|0
units.english: No sooner do you slow your step to give it your attention though, than the pile of crates immediately springs to life.
units.italian: Non fate in tempo a rallentare il passo per prestarvi attenzione che la pila di casse prende vita all'istante.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	Music plays and some half dozen robotic caricatures of Hai in exaggerated dress spring forth from various crates and begin to caper about in a series of interactions presumably intended to be comedic, at least judging by how they keep turning away from each other to "look" at the audience and wink. Holoprojected banners and glyphs, presumably advertisement information, flicker through a series of displays as it goes through a cycle before the entire cohort appear to finish up; each onlooker the recipient of some kind of entreaty from at least one robot, before they immediately clamber back into the crates.|282|0
units.english: Music plays and some half dozen robotic caricatures of Hai in exaggerated dress spring forth from various crates and begin to caper about in a series of interactions presumably intended to be comedic, at least judging by how they keep turning away from each other to "look" at the audience and wink. Holoprojected banners and glyphs, presumably advertisement information, flicker through a series of displays as it goes through a cycle before the entire cohort appear to finish up; each onlooker the recipient of some kind of entreaty from at least one robot, before they immediately clamber back into the crates.
units.italian: Parte la musica e una mezza dozzina di caricature robotiche di Hai in abiti esagerati saltano fuori da varie casse e si mettono a sgambettare in una serie di interazioni presumibilmente pensate per far ridere, a giudicare almeno da come continuano a voltarsi l'una dall'altra per "guardare" il pubblico e ammiccare. Striscioni e glifi olografici, presumibilmente informazioni pubblicitarie, scorrono attraverso una serie di schermate mentre il ciclo procede, finché l'intero gruppo sembra concludere; ogni spettatore riceve una qualche supplica da almeno un robot, prima che tutti si arrampichino di nuovo dentro le casse.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	Throughout this a handful of Hai have stopped to watch, and a couple of them let out small chuckles at the conclusion before continuing on their way. Most of them simply roll their eyes and move on though. One child wanders too close as their parents steer around it and a little red holographic warning sign briefly flashes at them. No one seems keen to explain what you just saw, and for the moment the crates remain resolutely closed.|283|0
units.english: Throughout this a handful of Hai have stopped to watch, and a couple of them let out small chuckles at the conclusion before continuing on their way. Most of them simply roll their eyes and move on though. One child wanders too close as their parents steer around it and a little red holographic warning sign briefly flashes at them. No one seems keen to explain what you just saw, and for the moment the crates remain resolutely closed.
units.italian: Per tutto il tempo una manciata di Hai si è fermata a guardare, e un paio ridacchiano alla conclusione prima di proseguire. I più si limitano a roteare gli occhi e tirare dritto. Un bambino si avvicina troppo mentre i genitori gli girano intorno e un piccolo cartello olografico rosso lampeggia verso di loro. Nessuno sembra avere voglia di spiegarvi cosa avete appena visto, e per il momento le casse restano ostinatamente chiuse.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	Now that you think about it, you're not sure they all climbed back into the same boxes they came out of.|287|0
units.english: Now that you think about it, you're not sure they all climbed back into the same boxes they came out of.
units.italian: Ora che ci pensate, non siete sicuri che siano tutti rientrati nelle stesse casse da cui erano usciti.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	Music plays and some half dozen robotic caricatures of Hai in exaggerated dress spring forth from various crates and begin to caper about in a series of interactions. Your translator struggles to keep up as they run through a rapid-fire string of presumably witty wordplay jokes that don't translate well. The humor appears to be improvisational at first, but the illusion is so good that the realization of the impossibility of robots improvising only catches up with you after the fact. The entire thing is set to a musical score, with beat rests at various points where the animatronic Hai keep turning away from each other to 'look' at the audience and wink. Holoprojected banners and glyphs flicker through a series of displays informing you that this is an advertisement for a fully robotic comedy musical called "The Grandmother's Rules." It claims to be complete with interactive heckling responses and provides a list of dates and venues, all in the far future, where it will be showing.|290|0
units.english: Music plays and some half dozen robotic caricatures of Hai in exaggerated dress spring forth from various crates and begin to caper about in a series of interactions. Your translator struggles to keep up as they run through a rapid-fire string of presumably witty wordplay jokes that don't translate well. The humor appears to be improvisational at first, but the illusion is so good that the realization of the impossibility of robots improvising only catches up with you after the fact. The entire thing is set to a musical score, with beat rests at various points where the animatronic Hai keep turning away from each other to 'look' at the audience and wink. Holoprojected banners and glyphs flicker through a series of displays informing you that this is an advertisement for a fully robotic comedy musical called "The Grandmother's Rules." It claims to be complete with interactive heckling responses and provides a list of dates and venues, all in the far future, where it will be showing.
units.italian: Parte la musica e una mezza dozzina di caricature robotiche di Hai in abiti esagerati saltano fuori da varie casse e si mettono a sgambettare in una serie di interazioni. Il vostro traduttore fatica a stare dietro a una raffica di battute che presumibilmente sono giochi di parole spiritosi e che si traducono male. L'umorismo sembra improvvisato all'inizio, ma l'illusione è così buona che vi rendete conto dell'impossibilità che dei robot improvvisino solo dopo. Il tutto è accompagnato da una partitura musicale, con pause di battuta in vari punti in cui gli Hai animatronici continuano a voltarsi l'uno dall'altro per 'guardare' il pubblico e ammiccare. Striscioni e glifi olografici scorrono in una serie di schermate che vi informano che questa è la pubblicità di un musical comico completamente robotico intitolato "Le regole della nonna". Sostiene di essere completo di risposte interattive alle provocazioni del pubblico e fornisce un elenco di date e locali, tutti in un futuro lontano, in cui sarà in scena.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	At the end each one of the robots strikes a pose and invites a different demographic to come along and "have the time of a decade," with ticket prices starting from 73 credits, before the entire cohort finish up and immediately clamber back into the crates. You're not sure they all climbed back into the same boxes they came out of.|291|0
units.english: At the end each one of the robots strikes a pose and invites a different demographic to come along and "have the time of a decade," with ticket prices starting from 73 credits, before the entire cohort finish up and immediately clamber back into the crates. You're not sure they all climbed back into the same boxes they came out of.
units.italian: Alla fine ognuno dei robot fa una posa e invita una diversa fascia di pubblico a venire a "vivere il decennio della propria vita", con biglietti a partire da 73 crediti, prima che l'intero gruppo concluda e si arrampichi subito di nuovo nelle casse. Non siete sicuri che siano tutti rientrati nelle stesse casse da cui erano usciti.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	Throughout this a handful of Hai have stopped to watch, and a couple of them let out small chuckles at the conclusion before continuing on their way. Most of them simply roll their eyes and move on though.|292|0
units.english: Throughout this a handful of Hai have stopped to watch, and a couple of them let out small chuckles at the conclusion before continuing on their way. Most of them simply roll their eyes and move on though.
units.italian: Per tutto il tempo una manciata di Hai si è fermata a guardare, e un paio ridacchiano alla conclusione prima di proseguire. I più si limitano a roteare gli occhi e tirare dritto.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	One middle-aged Hai in the crowd with racoon-like gray around his eyes wears the type of attire typical of their merchant captains. He eyes you curiously and steps over to you. "Well, well, Captain, that's a remarkable box you have there. Didn't know they'd started making live translator devices! Did it keep up alright?"|293|0
units.english: One middle-aged Hai in the crowd with racoon-like gray around his eyes wears the type of attire typical of their merchant captains. He eyes you curiously and steps over to you. "Well, well, Captain, that's a remarkable box you have there. Didn't know they'd started making live translator devices! Did it keep up alright?"
units.italian: Un Hai di mezza età nella folla, con un grigio da procione intorno agli occhi, indossa il tipo di abbigliamento tipico dei loro capitani mercantili. Vi scruta con curiosità e vi si avvicina. "Bene, bene, Capitano, che scatola notevole che ha lì. Non sapevo che avessero iniziato a fare dispositivi di traduzione dal vivo! È riuscita a starci dietro?"

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	"Oh, it's the first of its kind."|295|0
units.english: "Oh, it's the first of its kind."
units.italian: "Oh, è il primo del suo genere."

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	"I think I got the gist of it, though it only reads things out if I look directly at them."|297|0
units.english: "I think I got the gist of it, though it only reads things out if I look directly at them."
units.italian: "Credo di aver capito il senso, anche se legge solo se guardo direttamente le cose."

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	"Ah yes, I suppose that's a logical feature," he says. "I can only imagine it would be quite unwieldy if it tried to read out every piece of text in its vicinity.|298|0
units.english: "Ah yes, I suppose that's a logical feature," he says. "I can only imagine it would be quite unwieldy if it tried to read out every piece of text in its vicinity.
units.italian: "Ah sì, suppongo che sia una funzione logica," dice. "Immagino che sarebbe piuttosto scomodo se provasse a leggere ogni testo nei paraggi.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	"The first?" He studies you for a second. "Oh, you're Captain <last>! What a pleasure to meet you."|301|0
units.english: "The first?" He studies you for a second. "Oh, you're Captain <last>! What a pleasure to meet you."
units.italian: "Il primo?" Vi studia per un secondo. "Oh, lei è il Capitano <last>! Che piacere conoscerla."

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	He looks you up and down with a wry grin. "Somehow you're shorter than I expected.|302|0
units.english: He looks you up and down with a wry grin. "Somehow you're shorter than I expected.
units.italian: Vi guarda da capo a piedi con un sorriso sornione. "In qualche modo è più basso di quanto immaginassi.

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	"Well if you do get the chance, I do recommend the performance. I saw it a few months back and it really is quite good. Particularly popular on our worlds with many humans."|304|0
units.english: "Well if you do get the chance, I do recommend the performance. I saw it a few months back and it really is quite good. Particularly popular on our worlds with many humans."
units.italian: "Beh, se ne ha l'occasione, le consiglio lo spettacolo. L'ho visto qualche mese fa ed è davvero molto bello. Particolarmente popolare sui nostri mondi con molti umani."

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	He flicks you a friendly wave. "I must be off. Don't get too close to the displays, they don't like being touched!"|305|0
units.english: He flicks you a friendly wave. "I must be off. Don't get too close to the displays, they don't like being touched!"
units.italian: Vi saluta con un cenno amichevole. "Devo andare. Non si avvicini troppo ai display, non amano essere toccati!"

units.id: mission:Robotic Musical 1|	The Hai sounds very pleased as he ambles off, quietly chortling to himself as he departs.|306|0
units.english: The Hai sounds very pleased as he ambles off, quietly chortling to himself as he departs.
units.italian: L'Hai sembra molto soddisfatto mentre si allontana, ridacchiando tra sé e sé mentre se ne va.
